options: The air thins as the path climbs higher.
Rocky terrain stretches upward. The wind howls.
Mountain peaks loom in every direction.

text_options: An echo bounces off the cliff face — what caused it?
Something moves on the ridge above.
The mountain has surprises in store.
Mountain predators descend from the crags!
Bandits ambush you from the high ground!
Rock-dwellers emerge from cave openings!
A fierce mountain storm rolls in!
Snow begins to fall heavily.
Gale-force winds batter the exposed ridge.
You find mineral deposits in the rock face.
Ore glints in the stone — useful materials!
Mountain herbs grow in a sheltered crevice.
Loose scree slides under your feet!
You slip on the rocky path!
A false step on the narrow ledge!
The mountain stands silent and majestic.
Clear skies reveal breathtaking views. All is calm.
A peaceful moment at altitude.

options: Bitter cold and howling winds make the mountain treacherous.
Ice coats every surface. Movement becomes dangerous.
The mountain shows no mercy in the dark.

text_options: Ice creatures emerge from frozen caves!
Mountain beasts attack, driven by hunger!
Frost-hardened predators close in!
Ice! You slip and tumble!
The frozen path betrays you!
You weather the cold. It builds character.
The storm breaks briefly — a moment of respite.
The ice begins to thaw. Conditions improve.
Sunlight warms the peaks. The worst is over.
Spring returns to the mountain.
